name: Sport
blurb: Thi đấu, rèn luyện, tinh thần đồng đội

words.definitionEn: a person who is proficient in sports and other forms of physical exercise
words.example: Professional athletes often follow strict diets to maintain peak performance.

words.definitionEn: a series of contests between a number of competitors, who compete for an overall prize
words.example: The tennis tournament attracted top players from around the world.

words.definitionEn: the ability to sustain prolonged physical or mental effort
words.example: Marathon runners require exceptional endurance to complete the race.

words.definitionEn: the practice of training people to obey rules or a code of behavior
words.example: Self-discipline is crucial for athletes who want to improve their skills.

words.definitionEn: strong, healthy, and full of energy
words.example: Vigorous physical activity can reduce the risk of chronic diseases.

words.meaningVi: sức chịu đựng, thể lực bền bỉ
words.definitionEn: the ability to sustain prolonged physical or mental effort
words.example: Cyclists need to build up their stamina for long-distance races.

words.meaningVi: bị mất, bị tước (quyền, giải thưởng)
words.definitionEn: to lose or be deprived of (property, right, or prize) as a penalty for wrongdoing
words.example: The team had to forfeit the match due to a player eligibility issue.

words.meaningVi: tình đồng đội, tinh thần đoàn kết
words.definitionEn: mutual trust and friendship among people who spend a lot of time together
words.example: The camaraderie among teammates often leads to better performance on the field.

words.definitionEn: extremely thorough, exhaustive, or accurate
words.example: The training program is rigorous and demands full commitment from participants.

words.definitionEn: the ability to move quickly and easily
words.example: Basketball players rely on agility to dodge defenders and score points.

words.meaningVi: bục vinh quang, bục trao giải
words.definitionEn: a small platform on which a person may stand to be seen by an audience
words.example: Standing on the podium after winning a gold medal is a dream for many athletes.

words.definitionEn: a person who watches at a show, game, or other event
words.example: Spectators at the stadium cheered loudly when the home team scored.

words.definitionEn: very small in amount or effect
words.example: The athlete won by a marginal difference of only 0.01 seconds.

words.definitionEn: having a high reputation; respected and admired
words.example: Winning the prestigious championship elevated the team's status worldwide.

words.definitionEn: to stick firmly to a rule, decision, or plan
words.example: All players must adhere to the anti-doping regulations set by the governing body.

words.definitionEn: a prescribed course of medical treatment, diet, or exercise for the promotion of health
words.example: A strict training regimen is essential for athletes preparing for the Olympics.

words.meaningVi: kỹ năng xuất sắc, tài năng
words.definitionEn: skill or expertise in a particular activity or field
words.example: Her athletic prowess earned her a place on the national team.

words.meaningVi: sự trở ngại, thất bại tạm thời
words.definitionEn: a reversal or check in progress; a difficulty
words.example: Injuries can be a major setback for professional athletes.

words.definitionEn: to work jointly with others or together especially in an intellectual endeavor
words.example: Team members must collaborate effectively to achieve a common goal in sports.

words.definitionEn: to compel observance of or compliance with (a law, rule, or obligation)
words.example: Referees are responsible for enforcing the rules during a match.

words.definitionEn: a feature that renders something less acceptable; a disadvantage
words.example: One drawback of intense training is the increased risk of injury.

words.definitionEn: to make (an action or process) easy or easier
words.example: Proper warm-up exercises facilitate better performance and reduce injury risk.

words.definitionEn: to provide (someone) with a reason for doing something; to stimulate
words.example: Coaches often use positive reinforcement to motivate their athletes.

words.definitionEn: exceptionally good; remarkable
words.example: The team delivered an outstanding performance in the championship final.

words.meaningVi: tính kiên cường, khả năng phục hồi
words.definitionEn: the capacity to recover quickly from difficulties; toughness
words.example: Mental resilience is as important as physical strength in competitive sports.

words.definitionEn: a contest between individuals or teams
words.example: The competition was fierce, but our team managed to secure a place in the finals.

words.definitionEn: a competition in which people try to win
words.example: The annual swimming contest attracts participants from all over the country.

words.definitionEn: repeated exercise to improve a skill
words.example: Regular practice is essential for mastering any sport.

words.definitionEn: a person who trains a sports team or player
words.example: The coach emphasized the importance of discipline during the training session.

words.definitionEn: an official who enforces the rules of a game
words.example: The referee made a controversial decision that affected the outcome of the match.

words.definitionEn: a person or team that one competes against
words.example: Our opponents were well-prepared, but we managed to outplay them in the second half.

words.definitionEn: a member of the same team
words.example: Good communication with teammates is crucial for success in team sports.

words.definitionEn: an act of defeating an opponent
words.example: The team celebrated their hard-earned victory with great enthusiasm.

words.definitionEn: the act of losing a contest
words.example: Despite the defeat, the players showed great character and determination.

words.definitionEn: the number of points achieved in a game
words.example: The final score was 3-1, reflecting the superiority of the home team.

words.definitionEn: a punishment imposed for breaking a rule in a sport
words.example: The referee awarded a penalty for the foul committed inside the box.

words.meaningVi: chức vô địch, giải vô địch
words.definitionEn: a competition to find the best player or team in a particular sport
words.example: Winning the championship requires not only skill but also mental toughness.

words.definitionEn: a group of sports teams that play against each other
words.example: The team struggled in the league this season due to injuries.

words.definitionEn: a flat piece of metal given as a prize in a competition
words.example: She won a gold medal in the 100-metre sprint at the Olympics.

words.definitionEn: the best performance or highest level ever achieved
words.example: He broke the world record in the marathon with an astonishing time.

words.meaningVi: cuộc thử nghiệm, buổi thử sức
words.definitionEn: a test of someone's ability to play a sport
words.example: The young athlete impressed the scouts during the trial and was offered a contract.

words.definitionEn: a session of physical exercise
words.example: A proper workout routine should include both cardiovascular and strength training.

words.definitionEn: the condition of being physically fit and healthy
words.example: Athletes must maintain a high level of fitness to compete at the top level.

words.definitionEn: the ability to move different parts of the body together smoothly
words.example: Good hand-eye coordination is vital for sports like tennis and basketball.

words.definitionEn: the combined effort of a group of people working together effectively
words.example: Effective teamwork often determines the success of a sports team more than individual talent.

words.definitionEn: fair, generous, and polite behaviour in a sport
words.example: The athlete was praised for his sportsmanship after helping his injured opponent.

words.definitionEn: the planned methods used to achieve a particular goal in a game
words.example: The coach's clever tactics neutralized the opponent's strengths.

words.definitionEn: the combined power of a group that is greater than the sum of its parts
words.example: The synergy between the players created a formidable team that outperformed expectations.

words.definitionEn: the use of banned substances to enhance performance
words.example: Doping scandals have tarnished the reputation of several sports.

words.definitionEn: the act of being removed from a competition for breaking the rules
words.example: The athlete faced disqualification after testing positive for a banned substance.
